item.title: Minimalist One-Page Company Website
item.description:
20-250 GBP | I’m looking to launch a clean, single-page site that presents my packaging company at a glance. The sole purpose is to provide clear company information, so I want the layout ultra-minimal, quick to load and easy to navigate.
Content flow 1. About Us – a concise snapshot of our story and values. 2. Products & Services – short descriptions supported by product photos I’ll supply. 3. Contact Information – a simple form that sends enquiries straight to my email, plus our address and phone number.
Design & build notes • White space, muted brand colours and modern typography are key. • Fully responsive on desktop, tablet and mobile. • Light tech stack is fine: pure HTML/CSS, or wordpress is fine • No heavy animations—subtle scroll or fade effects only if they don’t slow the page.
Deliverable A production-ready, one-page website with all assets and a brief hand-off guide showing me how to update text or images.
When you apply, please link to past minimalist or single-page sites you’ve created so I can judge style and code quality quickly.

item.title: Clone PacificTours.ca SEO-Optimized Site
item.description:
30-250 CAD | I need an exact functional replica of pacifictours.ca, brought over to a fresh, fully responsive build that is ready for on-page SEO from day one. All core sections are required—Home page, Tours and Packages, Contact Us, About Us, Book Now, plus the FAQ & Policy pages—so content structure must match the original while loading quickly on both desktop and mobile.
I do have a few adjustments in mind. The overall look should feel familiar, but the layout needs tidying for smoother user flow and stronger calls-to-action. Most importantly, the new site must include an integrated booking component that handles real-time availability and confirmations. I’m open to your preferred tech stack as long as it stays lightweight, secure, and easy for my team to update.
Deliverables • Pixel-perfect recreation of the listed pages • Clean, modular layout modifications that improve UX without losing brand feel • Booking integration tested end-to-end (sandbox data is fine) • On-page SEO foundations: semantic HTML, meta tags, XML sitemap, fast page speed scores • Migration or redirect plan so the current domain can switch over with zero downtime
Final acceptance will be based on a live staging link where I can run through every page, complete a test booking, and verify SEO readiness via Lighthouse or a similar tool.

item.title: Web Design Specialist Needed
item.description:
30-250 USD | I am looking for a reliable freelancer to help create a simple, modern, and user-friendly website using HTML and CSS. The goal is to build a clean website layout with a professional appearance and a well-organized structure.
The website should include a clear navigation menu, a header, a main content area, and a footer. The design should be visually appealing, with appropriate spacing, readable typography, and consistent colors. The layout should also be responsive so that it displays correctly on desktop computers, tablets, and mobile devices.
The project requires basic knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3, including page layout, styling, Flexbox or Grid, and responsive design techniques. The code should be clean, properly structured, and easy to update in the future.
I will provide the project requirements and any necessary design references. The freelancer should follow the instructions carefully and make reasonable adjustments to the layout when needed.
This is a straightforward frontend project. No JavaScript, backend development, database integration, or complicated functionality is required.
The final deliverable should include all HTML and CSS source files, with the website layout tested for responsiveness and basic browser compatibility.
If you are interested in this project, please send a brief introduction and examples of similar websites you have created using HTML and CSS. I look forward to working with someone who can deliver clean code and a polished result.

item.title: Shopify Wizard: Store Duplication & Custom Theme Development
item.description:
750-1500 EUR | Experienced Shopify Developer – Store Duplication, Custom Theme Development & Subscription System
We are looking for a highly experienced Shopify developer to help us duplicate an existing Shopify store, develop a customized theme based on our design layouts, and implement advanced subscription functionality according to our specific requirements. We are looking for a long-term development partner, not just someone to complete a single project.
1. Shopify Store Duplication & Setup - Duplicate an existing Shopify store into a new Shopify environment. - Transfer products, collections, pages, navigation, and relevant store configurations. - Set up and configure all necessary Shopify apps. - Ensure that existing functionality is correctly transferred or recreated. - Configure multilingual and international store functionality if required.
2. Custom Shopify Theme Development - Develop and customize Shopify themes based on our provided graphic designs (Figma, Photoshop, etc.). - Implement pixel-perfect designs with a strong focus on usability. - Mobile-first development is essential. - Create custom sections, templates, and reusable components. - Develop responsive layouts optimized for smartphones, tablets, and desktops. - Implement custom functionality using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. - Ensure excellent loading speed, performance, and clean code.
3. Custom Subscription Development - Develop and customize a Shopify subscription system according to our specific requirements. - Integrate and extend existing subscription apps where possible. - Implement custom subscription rules, restrictions, and purchasing logic. - Develop advanced subscription management functionality. - Customize the customer subscription portal. - Implement product quantity restrictions, subscription modifications, and other custom features. - Develop custom Shopify apps or integrations where necessary. Important: We need a developer who understands Shopify subscription architecture and is capable of implementing complex requirements beyond standard app functionality.
4. Shopify Apps & Custom Functionality - Install, configure, and customize Shopify apps. - Develop custom Shopify apps when required. - Integrate third-party services and APIs. - Implement custom product and checkout-related functionality within Shopify's technical limitations. - Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
5. Testing, Optimization & Maintenance - Test all functionality across different devices and browsers. - Optimize website performance and loading speed. - Identify and fix bugs. - Provide ongoing technical support and improvements. Required Skills - Extensive experience with Shopify development. - Strong knowledge of Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. - Experience with Shopify APIs and custom app development. - Proven experience with Shopify subscription systems. - Experience translating Figma or Photoshop layouts into fully functional Shopify themes. - Strong understanding of mobile-first and responsive design. - Experience with Shopify Markets and multilingual stores is a plus. - Ability to work independently and deliver reliable solutions.
What We Offer - Long-term collaboration with regular development tasks. - Clear project requirements and provided design layouts. - Direct communication and quick feedback. - Opportunities to work on multiple Shopify stores. - Flexible working arrangements.

item.title: ADA Compliance for Non-Profit Website
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need an experienced developer to update our Wildapricot website for ADA compliance. This is for a non-profit organization.
Key requirements: - Make the site accessible for screen readers, keyboard navigation, and voice recognition. - Update navigation and menus, images and media, and forms and interactive elements.
Ideal skills and experience: - Proven experience with ADA compliance - Familiarity with Wildapricot - Knowledge of accessibility standards and best practices - Experience with assistive technologies
I would also like to have the option for occasional updates or maintenance after the initial work is done.

item.title: Port AI-Generated HTML Web Page to WordPress Elementor with SEO & Documentation
item.description:
30-250 CAD | I need a skilled freelancer to port my AI-generated HTML web page to WordPress using Elementor. The Golf Industry site must match the original design and be fully mobile responsive. The freelancer will need to extract all content and assets from the current live site. Tasks include: - Complete setup of the page on my hosting - Replicating layout and functionality in Elementor - Ensuring full mobile responsiveness - Setting up basic on-page SEO (titles, meta descriptions) - Providing clear instructions and documentation for future edits
Ideal freelancer will have experience with Elementor, WordPress migrations, and SEO best practices. Attention to detail and strong communication skills are essential. Background and strong knowledge of the game of golf, specifically golf course websites is important but not required.

item.title: Wix Website Redesign for Wellness Brand
item.description:
250-750 GBP | Description:
I'm Rich, a UK author and founder of Metanoia, a brand built around mental strength and inner discipline. It includes books, a newsletter, coaching programmes and a clothing line. I need an experienced Wix designer to rebuild my existing site, metanoiatransformation.com, so that it sells.
What the site must do
• Sell three things: clothing, coaching programmes and books. • Show two books as "coming soon", with a waitlist sign-up on each. • Offer a free Week 1 download in exchange for an email address, connected to my newsletter on Beehiiv. • Work well on a phone first.
What I need built
1. A new homepage: a hero, three doors (Book, Course, Clothing), a free-sample sign-up, a short "how it works" section and a newsletter box. 2. Pages for coaching, the two books, an About page and a Contact page. 3. A shop connected to print-on-demand (I'll confirm the supplier), with product pages, sizing, shipping and returns. 4. Navigation by what a visitor wants to do: Start here, Course, Book, Shop, Letter. 5. Basic SEO, fast loading and a cookie banner and privacy page that meet UK GDPR rules.
Design I'll supply a brand sheet and a brand identity document with exact colours, fonts and logo files. The look is natural and calm: linen and sand backgrounds, a warm brown for text, and a small amount of pale green. No black, and no loud or "hustle" styling. Headlines are in Cormorant Garamond and body text in Inter. Please don't use stock templates that look generic.
What I'll provide: logo files, colours, fonts, copy for the main pages, and product details as they are ready.
Who I'm looking for
• Proven Wix and Wix Stores experience, with links to two or three live sites close to this brief. • Print-on-demand shop experience, ideally in the UK. • Clean, editorial design. • Clear communication in English.
To apply, please:
• Send two relevant examples. • Confirm what is included in your price: pages, revisions (I expect at least two rounds) and handover, including a short video showing me how to edit the site myself. • Give a timeline in working days and what you need from me. • Say whether you will work in my existing Wix account.
Budget: [your budget] fixed price, paid in milestones: homepage, then remaining pages, then shop.
I'd suggest starting the contract with the homepage and waitlist only, and adding the shop in a second contract once the products are ready.

item.title: Wine Education Website Development
item.description:
20-250 GBP | I'm seeking a skilled web developer to create an informative and engaging website for my wine education and consultancy services. The primary purpose of the site is to educate visitors about wines, while also showcasing my wine tasting sessions and consultancy services.
Key Features Required: - Comprehensive Education Section: This will include articles, blogs, video tutorials, and infographics on various wine topics. - Services Showcase: Detailed descriptions of wine tasting sessions and wine consultancy services. - User-Friendly Navigation: The site should be easy to navigate, ensuring visitors can effortlessly find the information they need. - Responsive Design: The website must be mobile-friendly and look great on all devices. - SEO Optimization: To ensure the site ranks well on search engines and attracts a broad audience.
Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proven experience in developing educational websites, with a portfolio to showcase. - Strong SEO knowledge and implementation skills. - Expertise in creating user-friendly, responsive designs. - Excellent content organization and navigation structuring abilities.
Please provide a portfolio with your bid.

item.title: Healthy Eating Website and Blog
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need a clean, responsive website dedicated to healthy eating. The core of the build is a searchable, filter-friendly recipe database where visitors can quickly find dishes by ingredient, dietary preference, or prep time. Alongside the recipes, I want an easy-to-update blog section for articles, tips, and success stories.
A CMS such as WordPress, Ghost, or a similarly straightforward platform is fine as long as I can add new recipes and posts without touching code. Please structure the database so each recipe has its own page, categories, tags, nutrition facts, and a printable view. The blog should share the same design language and SEO setup.
Key deliverables • Fully responsive website (desktop, tablet, mobile) • Recipe database with advanced search/filter and nutrition fields • Blog section integrated into the same CMS • Modern, lightweight design tuned for fast load times • Basic on-page SEO (schema for recipes, meta tags, clean URLs) • Clear documentation or a quick video walk-through showing me how to add content
Nice-to-have (not required but mention if you can handle it): an interactive meal planner that could plug into the recipe data later.
I expect clean code, scoped CSS/utility classes, and accessibility best practices. Let me know your preferred stack, any relevant portfolio links, and an estimated timeline from kickoff to launch.

item.title: Wix E-Commerce Store With Chat
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I need a complete Wix-based online store that will let me sell physical products seamlessly. The key requirement is a built-in live-chat feature so I can answer customer questions in real time and boost conversions.
I already have a Wix account and a product list ready to upload; what I am missing is a visually appealing, mobile-responsive storefront, intuitive navigation, secure checkout, and the chat integration configured to match my brand’s look and feel. If you can also suggest apps or settings inside Wix that optimise inventory tracking, taxes, and shipping, that would be a bonus.
Once the site is live I’d like a quick walkthrough or short loom video covering how to add new items, process orders, and manage the chat dashboard, so I can run the store myself without constant developer help.
Deliverables: • Fully designed Wix store for physical goods • Live chat set up and styled • Payment and shipping rules configured and tested • Admin hand-off guide or video
If you have experience launching product-focused Wix sites with real-time support, I’m eager to see your portfolio and timeline.

item.title: Corporate Site Migration & Updates
item.description:
30-250 CAD | I'm looking for a quote to migrate our existing WordPress website to a new hosting server and update the website's software and plugins.
Project Scope:
Website Migration
Transfer the complete WordPress website, including all files, databases, images, and content.
Maintain the existing design, layout, and functionality.
Configure the new server, SSL certificate, and required settings.
WordPress & Plugin Updates
Update WordPress, PHP, and all existing plugins to current, compatible versions. All plugs ins should be subscription free.
Resolve any compatibility issues resulting from the updates.
Identify any outdated or unnecessary plugins for review.
Testing & Migration
Complete the migration and updates on a staging server before switching the live website.
Test all pages, links, contact forms, and functionality on desktop and mobile.
Ensure minimal downtime and a seamless transition.
Maintain a full backup of the original website in case restoration is required.
Ensure our existing business email services are not affected.
Final Handover
Confirm the website is fully operational following migration.
Provide full administrative access and hosting credentials.
Ensure the website is secure and automatic backups are configured.
Quote & Timeline
Please provide:
A fixed-price quote for the complete migration and updates.
An estimated project timeline and completion date.
Any anticipated downtime.
Recommended hosting requirements and associated costs.
A post-migration warranty period to address any issues related to the transfer.
We are not interested in an ongoing website maintenance or support contract. We intend to hire technical assistance on an as-needed basis for future updates or changes.
Our objective is to have a fully updated, secure, independently hosted website that operates seamlessly without requiring ongoing management services.

item.title: Simple Scalable E-commerce Site
item.description:
1500-3000 USD | I'm looking for an experienced developer to create a small e-commerce store with either Shopify or WooCommerce on WordPress. The site will initially feature one product with three skus, but I need it to be scalable to accommodate additional products and skus in the future.
Essential Features: - Customer reviews integration - Email software integration (Mailerlite) - Square payment processing - Use of cards/carousels on website pages - schema markup - Set a minimum order quantity for purchases
Design: I already have a logo but I'm unsure about the website design style. I’m open to suggestions that complement my brand.

item.title: Business Portal with Product Catalog
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need a clean, professional-looking business portal and help securing an appropriate domain name for it. The site’s primary purpose is to showcase our range of products, so the catalog must be front-and-center and easy for non-technical staff to update. At this stage I do not want online payments or a shopping-cart flow—products only need clear photos, descriptions, SKUs and a simple enquiry button that can route to our sales inbox.
Please handle the full set-up, from registering the domain through to launching the site on a live host. I am flexible on the platform (WordPress, Laravel, custom React, etc.) as long as it stays lightweight, mobile-friendly and SEO-ready. A straightforward CMS dashboard for adding new items and editing content is essential.
Deliverables: • Domain name registered and pointed to hosting • Responsive business portal deployed and tested • Product catalog section with add/edit capability, no payment gateway • Basic on-page SEO and submission to search engines • Brief hand-off guide so my team can maintain the catalog
If anything in the scope needs clarification, let me know—I’d like to move quickly once the domain is secured.

item.title: Mobile Personal Finance Website Partner - Palestine
item.description:
1000-20000 USD | I am building a mobile-first website that allows users to track their debts in one place. The goal is to launch a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) quickly, followed by continuous development and improvement. I am looking for a highly skilled developer interested in a long-term partnership. Given the nature of the work during this initial phase, the developer must be based in Palestine.
Core Scope of Work: • Design and develop a responsive web application that provides a seamless user experience, similar to a native mobile app. • Build a secure user registration system, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). • Develop core modules for personal finance management: adding and editing transactions, categorizing expenses, and a clear dashboard displaying balances and spending trends. • Establish a scalable back-end architecture and well-structured APIs, with comprehensive code documentation to facilitate the addition of new features post-launch.
I am open to using any tech stack that enables rapid development and future scalability—for example, React or Vue for the front-end, and Node, Laravel, or a similar framework for the back-end. I place a high priority on clean architecture, robust test coverage, and efficient deployment mechanisms (such as Docker and CI/CD pipelines).
Required Deliverables for the Initial Phase: 1. A fully responsive front-end integrated with an efficient database. 2. A comprehensive system for account creation, login, and password recovery, secured with multi-factor authentication (MFA). 3. Interfaces for adding, editing, and categorizing financial transactions, along with a dashboard that summarizes the data. 4. Delivery of the source code via a private repository, accompanied by a brief session to hand over the project and explain its details.
If you are a developer based in Palestine and are interested in co-founding a product and contributing to its growth, let’s discuss the next steps, timelines, and how to structure this partnership.

item.title: Family Law Directory Marketing
item.description:
8-15 AUD/hr | I run an online directory dedicated to family-law services. Listing a firm is free, yet most practices still haven’t heard about us. I’m looking for a marketer who can set up an ongoing campaign that puts the directory in front of more family-law businesses first, while keeping an eye on future outreach to the general public.
Here’s what I need help with right now:
• Strategy & platform setup – Build a full marketing workflow inside Go High Level (or a comparable all-in-one system) covering lead capture forms, segmented lists, email templates and automated sequences. – Integrate the workflow with my WordPress site so firms can self-register, submit blog articles and instantly enter our CRM.
• Email marketing – Craft a regular newsletter aimed at family-law practices featuring industry updates and news (this is the content they value most). – Design an additional monthly newsletter for consumer leads once that list begins to grow. – Set clear metrics for open rate, click-through rate and directory sign-ups.
• Social & partnership outreach – Develop a short-form social calendar (LinkedIn first, other channels as relevant) that drives traffic back to the listing page. – Identify and approach potential partners—family-law associations, legal-tech vendors, accountants—to arrange simple cross-promotions or guest content swaps.
• Database growth – Create opt-in funnels that encourage visitors who contact listed firms to join our mailing list. – Ensure all data collection is GDPR/Spam-Act compliant and tagged properly for future segmentation.
Acceptance criteria 1. Go High Level (or agreed equivalent) fully configured, tested and live. 2. First two business newsletters written, scheduled and proofed. 3. Social calendar delivered for the upcoming month. 4. Minimum of one partnership proposal ready to send. 5. Reporting dashboard showing subscriber growth and directory sign-ups.
If you’ve already managed similar multi-channel campaigns within Go High Level and can show measurable results, let’s talk.

item.title: Full Time, Long Term Process Automation, Vacation Home Rental, and Real Estate Operations & Marketing Role
item.description:
250-750 USD | DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NOT WILLING / COMFORTABLE WITH VIDEO CALLS. DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT ANSWER ALL THE QUESTIONS AT END OF DESCRIPTION. "DISCUSS LATER" OR "PROVIDE LATER" WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. DO NOT WASTE TIME TO SEND GENERIC APPLICATION. WILL IMMEDIATELY DELET. Received hundreds of applications so only those with sincerity in going through the job description and asnwering every question with concrete answers will be contacted.
About the Role I am a realtor, short term rental manager, and interior designer based in Canada seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Remote executive assistant to support daily operations and me. This role is ideal for someone experienced in zapier automation with customization and some basic custom code editing, real estate research, short term rental management, data organization, scheduling, and marketing support. You will work closely with me to help streamline operations, transactions, research properties, and maintain marketing activities.
Key Responsibilities
1. Short Term Rental Management - Experience in managing short term rental operations - Ability to follow SOPs and check-lists in details
2. Simple Web and Automation Support - Experience in updating Wordpress websites - Experience in setting up task automation usng Zapier or Maker
3. Property Research - Search for properties based on specific client criteria using MLS and other real estate platforms - Compile property lists for buyers and investment opportunities - Monitor new listings and notify the realtor of relevant opportunities
4. Price & Market Analysis - Conduct competitive market analysis (CMA) on comparable properties - Research recent sales, active listings, and neighborhood trends - Prepare organized reports and spreadsheets summarizing market data
5. Appointment Coordination - Schedule property showings, meetings, and client appointments - Coordinate calendars and confirm appointments with clients and vendors - Send reminders and maintain organized schedules
6. Marketing Support - Assist with social media posting and online marketing campaigns - Prepare marketing materials (flyers, brochures, email campaigns) - Support CRM updates and lead tracking - Help organize marketing and follow-ups
7. Administrative Support - Maintain project, property and client databases - Organize documents and files related to listings and transactions - Assist with basic email communication and task coordination
Qualifications - Previous experience in Short Term Rental and Real Estate Virtual Assistant is a must; not long term property management - Familiarity with Zapier and Wordpress a must - Strong research and data organization skills - Familiarity with short term rental and real estate terminology and basic market analysis - Experience with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel) - Experience with CRM systems and marketing tools is a plus - Strong written English communication skills - Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable - Ability to work independently and meet deadlines but also able to collaborate in team environment and do zoom meetings daily
Preferred Skills - Experience with web develop tools and process automation tools a must - Experience working with North American short term rental and real estate agents preferred - Knowledge of Airbnb, VRBO, etc and MLS systems, Zillow, or similar platforms - Graphic design experience (Canva or similar tools) - Familiarity of AI assisted content generation: writing, images, and video - Social media management experience (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn)
Compensation - fixed pay; will not consider hourly - Long-term opportunity and potentially convert to full time if interested
How to Apply, Please submit: 1. Are you able to work 8 hours a day / 5 days a week PST from 8AM to 5PM PST with one hour break in between? 2. Your resume 3. A short introduction about your experience working on Zapier 4. A short introduction on your experience with short term rental 5. A short introduction on your experience working with real estate agents 6. Portfolio examples of any automation, real estate, marketing work, administrative support, website work you have done 7. Your expected monthly pay for full time 8 hours a day / 5 days a week role

item.title: WordPress Development & SEO Expert Needed- 5
item.description:
250-750 USD | SEO & WEBSITE DEVELOPER (WordPress) — Remote, Monthly Pay
About Us Our Company helps entrepreneurs start and grow their businesses. Our wordpress website is our storefront, and organic search is a core growth channel. We are hiring one person to own both: keep our WordPress site running perfectly and grow qualified organic traffic that turns into leads, sign-ups, and customers.
Starting Pay $300 USD per month, paid monthly. Pay is earned by completing the listed tasks and metrics on a signed weekly checklist, released after a 4-week+ review, paid upon completion of KPI metrics.
Schedule Flexible remote, fixed hours workday with a 30-minute lunch. Daily short written update to Admin; weekly report every Friday.
What You Will Do
Website Developer (WordPress site health) - Keep every page working perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop: no broken layouts, menus, images, links, or forms. - Test login, sign-up, password reset, order buttons, checkout, and all forms end to end. - Keep page speed under 3 seconds and Core Web Vitals green. - Run plugin, theme, and WordPress core updates on staging first, with a current backup, then apply live. - Fix issues the same day or escalate with a screenshot and page URL. - Weekly cross-browser check (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).
SEO & Organic Growth - Publish 100 SEO-optimized templated pages per month (25 per week) through our page generator, using our master template. Upkeep and edit master templates as needed. - Do keyword research: long-tail, intent-driven, clustered, one primary keyword per page. - Earn 100 quality backlinks per month (DR 30–50+) through manual outreach. No PBNs, link farms, spam directories, or paid link networks. Paid placements require written approval in advance. - Technical SEO: keep Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog warnings at zero. Fix redirects, 404s, indexing, schema, and speed issues. - Conversion engineering: every page has a clear value proposition, benefit-driven H1, primary call to action, trust elements, and verified event tracking. - First 30 days: establish a documented baseline for organic sessions, leads, registrations, purchases, and conversion rate, and propose weekly/monthly growth targets for approval. Then report baseline vs. target vs. actual every Friday.
Member Website Publishing - Own customer website publishing requests from intake to completion: connect domains, verify DNS and SSL, publish the site, test layouts/forms/links, and confirm completion with the customer. - Set up staging builds and handle customer DNS updates. - Occasional quick WordPress pages or micro-sites using native Gutenberg blocks.
Tools You Will Use WordPress, Rank Math, Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and our internal SEO dashboard (keyword pipeline, page generator, rank tracker).
Requirements - Proven WordPress experience: themes, plugins, staging, backups, troubleshooting. - Working SEO knowledge: on-page, technical, keyword research, and manual link outreach. - Comfortable in Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog. - Gutenberg block editor experience (no third-party page builders). - Strong written English for daily and weekly reports. - Reliable internet and consistent daily availability. - You own routine fixes yourself and escalate only access, budget, security, or major platform decisions — with evidence and a recommended next step.
How We Measure Success (KPIs) - 100 new quality-checked SEO pages per month - 100 audited quality backlinks per month - Site load under 3 seconds; zero open technical warnings at week end - Weekly acquisition report every Friday; keyword report every Monday - Zero broken pages, forms, or layouts left open past 24 hours - Organic sessions, leads, registrations, and purchases growing against the approved baseline
How To Apply Send: (1) a short intro, (2) links to 2–3 WordPress sites you have managed or built, (3) one example of SEO results you produced (traffic, rankings, or links — with dates), and (4) we will hire on a level 1 which is similar to a paid task. It's 25% of the workload and pay. This will allow the candidate to work towards a level 2 that is fully functioning at 100% workload and pay for this role as promoting up becomes available.

item.title: WordPress Redesign & Sister Site Duplication
item.description:
30-250 USD | I’m ready to refresh my current WordPress site with a modern, minimalist theme, then roll the new look out to two sister businesses that sit on their own domains.
Here’s what I need done:
• Replace the existing theme with a clean, modern-minimalist template and ensure all core pages keep their current URLs and SEO settings. • Update three home-page sections—banner image, featured products/services, and customer testimonials—so they fit the new style. • Duplicate the finished site twice, swapping each clone’s logo, primary colour palette, and contact details. I’d like the overall layout to stay recognisably similar, but feel free to introduce small variations that give each brand its own personality. • Hand over fully functional sites with responsive design checked on desktop, tablet, and mobile, plus brief instructions on how I can tweak text or images myself later.
All work must be done inside WordPress; if you prefer Elementor, Gutenberg, or another reputable page builder, that’s fine as long as performance stays fast.
Once everything is live I’ll review each site. I’ll release the final milestone when pages load correctly, links work, and the new branding appears consistently across all three domains.
My current website Electrohubltd.co.uk The site need 2 pricing structures public and trade or end user and trade no prices should be displayed unless they have signed up for a acc.
Must be responsive and leach site must be Seo Friendly and all sites must be uploaded to respective domain and configured and must be responsive to work a all devices

item.title: Modern Electronics E-commerce Site Design -- 2
item.description:

item.title: Boost Blog Traffic From Google
item.description:

15-120 USD/hr | I'm looking for a skilled full stack developer to create a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for a supply chain solutions company. This project is for starting a new enterprise and is crucial for our business launch.
The software will have four user interfaces: - Admin Dashboard - Supplier Portal - Customer Interface - Contract Manufacturer Portal
The primary function of these interfaces will be to manage and track capacity.
Ideal Skills and Experience: - Expertise in full stack development - Experience in building user-friendly dashboards and portals - Familiarity with supply chain management software - Ability to integrate real-time data tracking and reporting features - Strong UI/UX design skills
Looking forward to your bids!

item.title: Build 40 Suburb Pages
item.description:
2-8 AUD/hr | I’m rolling out a new section on my site and need 40 suburb-specific pages completed quickly—each one should take no more than 5-10 minutes once you get into the rhythm. I’ll send you a link to an existing suburb page so you can mirror its layout, voice, and formatting; stick to that structure throughout.
Every page must highlight two core elements:
• Local attractions that give visitors a sense of what makes the suburb worth a visit or a move • Key demographics (population snapshot, median age, household type, or any other figures already shown on the reference page)
You’ll simply plug these details into the template that’s already working on my site, keeping headings, sub-headings, and call-outs consistent. The CMS is straightforward (WordPress), so if you’re comfortable with the block editor this will move fast.
Deliverables • 40 live suburb pages published in the site’s existing format • Each page includes concise attractions copy plus demographic stats • Internal links, meta title, and meta description filled in exactly as on the reference model
I’ll provide: 1. The reference link and login credentials 2. A spreadsheet listing all 40 suburbs with any starter data I have available
Once the first page is approved you can batch the rest. Quick, clean execution is the priority here; accuracy and consistency across pages will be my acceptance criteria.

item.title: Professional Life Coach Website Overhaul
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | My immediate priority is to refresh my life-coaching website so it reflects the polished, professional image I give clients in person. The current site feels dated and clunky; I’d like it transformed into something clean, corporate and easy to navigate.
Here’s what I need from you right now: • Redesign the overall layout to look modern and executive while staying welcoming. • Rewrite or refine page copy so the value of my programmes is crystal clear and SEO-friendly. • Enhance functionality—streamlined booking, responsive design, faster load times and an intuitive blog area are must-haves.
I already have brand colours and a logo that work; you’re free to recommend subtle tweaks if they’ll strengthen the professional feel. Please build on WordPress (current host is SiteGround) so I can edit content myself later, and ensure any plug-ins are stable and lightweight.
Once we nail the website, I plan to move on to social media management and updated marketing collateral, so a holistic eye for branding is appreciated—even if our first milestone stays firmly on the site itself.
When you reply, briefly outline: 1. A similar corporate-style site you’ve completed. 2. Your proposed timeline for mock-ups, development, testing and launch. 3. How you’ll ensure fault-free migration with zero downtime.
Looking forward to collaborating on a site that truly represents the calibre of my coaching practice.

item.title: WooCommerce B2C Store Development
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I am looking for someone based in the USA. I need to upgrade and launch a B2C online store and to build it on WooCommerce to keep everything within the WordPress ecosystem I already know. I need a developer who can take the project.
The build must include: • Seamless payment gateway integration (multiple providers preferred for redundancy). • A robust inventory management setup that syncs stock in real time. • A product review system that lets verified buyers leave ratings and photos.
Beyond those essentials, I’d like clean, responsive styling, fast loading times, and straightforward options for future add-ons such as marketing plugins or multilingual support. Once the site is live I’ll handle day-to-day content updates myself, so clear admin documentation is important.
If you have solid WooCommerce experience and can commit to regular progress check-ins, I’d love to hear how you’d approach this build and the timeline you’d need to deliver the finished store.

item.title: React Developer – Figma to Pixel-Perfect Marketing Site
item.description:
2-8 USD/hr | We have a fully designed marketing website in Figma and need an experienced frontend developer to translate it into production-quality React code. This is an implementation project — the design is finalized and we need precise, clean code that matches it exactly.
Requirements: - Strong proficiency in React (functional components, hooks) - Experience working with Lovable (formerly GPT Engineer) or similar AI-assisted React platforms - Proven ability to implement pixel-perfect UI from Figma designs - Solid understanding of HTML5 and modern CSS (Flexbox, Grid, responsive design) - Ability to work within an existing React project structure without breaking current functionality - Attention to detail — we expect the final output to match the Figma spec closely - Experience with marketing/landing page builds is a plus
Deliverables: - Fully implemented React components matching the provided Figma designs - Responsive layout that works across desktop, tablet, and mobile - Clean, maintainable code integrated into our existing React/Lovable project - Any necessary assets properly handled (images, icons, fonts) - Final review pass to ensure visual accuracy against the Figma file
Work Arrangement: This is a fixed-scope project based on implementing an already-completed Figma design into an existing codebase. We expect a relatively fast turnaround from a developer who can hit the ground running.
About the project: We are building a marketing website for an ecommerce brand and the design phase is complete — we simply need a skilled developer to bring it to life in React with precision and professionalism.

item.title: Fix Sign-In/Sign-Up Functionality and UI Issues on SaaS Website
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | I am looking for an experienced web developer to troubleshoot and fix the sign-in and sign-up functionality, resolve related UI issues, and improve the overall user experience on SaaS Project.
The primary objective is to make the authentication process fully functional, reliable, user-friendly, and visually consistent with the rest of the website.
The developer will need to inspect the existing codebase, identify the root causes of the reported issues, implement appropriate fixes, and thoroughly test the changes without negatively affecting existing website functionality.
Scope of Work
1. Sign-In Functionality
Investigate and fix issues preventing users from signing in successfully. Verify email and password authentication. Ensure appropriate handling of invalid credentials and authentication failures. Fix issues with form submission, button actions, and loading states. Verify that users are redirected to the correct page after successful login. Check session handling and ensure authenticated users remain signed in as expected. Investigate and fix Google sign-in if it is affected or not functioning correctly.
2. Sign-Up and User Registration
Investigate and fix issues with new user registration. Ensure users can complete the registration process successfully. Validate required fields, email formats, and password requirements. Display clear and helpful validation messages when information is missing or invalid. Prevent duplicate submissions and handle existing accounts appropriately. Verify that newly registered users are processed correctly by the backend and database. Fix any issues with registration confirmation or email verification, if applicable.
3. UI Fixes and Improvements
Identify and fix visual issues on the sign-in and sign-up pages. Correct alignment, spacing, padding, margins, and element sizing. Improve the layout and consistency of input fields, buttons, labels, links, and form containers. Ensure input fields and buttons display correctly in their default, focused, disabled, loading, and error states. Fix overlapping elements, broken layouts, inconsistent typography, and other visual defects.
Ideal Candidate
The ideal developer has experience debugging existing web applications, fixing authentication issues, improving frontend UI, and troubleshooting frontend/backend integration.
Please review the existing website before submitting your proposal. In your bid, briefly describe your relevant experience, how you would investigate these issues, your estimated completion time, and any information you would need to get started.
The priority is to fix the underlying problems efficiently while preserving the website's existing functionality and visual identity.
Skills Required
Web Development, JavaScript, Typescript, Node.js, Next.js, Postgresql, API Integration, Web Security, Software Testing

item.title: API Integration for Travel Marketplace
item.description:
12-18 EUR/hr | I run a travel marketplace (frankenbridge.com) with a working Cloudflare Worker that proxies the Bókun API into a React tour-browser app on WordPress. I want to add many more external tour and activity suppliers, but I don’t know which booking system each one uses. Some may be OCTO/Ventrata, Rezdy, FareHarbor, TourCMS or Checkfront, and others may have a custom API, an XML feed or none at all. I need an expert who has integrated many of these systems. First, identify what each supplier uses and the best way to connect it, and tell me honestly when an integration isn’t worth building. Then build the integrations so tours, availability and prices appear in one unified grid and bookings reach the right supplier. Keep supplier keys server-side and document everything. You work on staging with sandbox credentials only; I never share production keys. I’m starting with a paid audit of my first few suppliers, then we agree the build step by step. Please propose your own audit fee and hourly rate.
Moreover, we are a small travel company near Frankfurt, Germany. Our website, frankenbridge.com, sells small-group local tours to travelers from the US, Canada and Latin America. It runs on WordPress, Elementor and TranslatePress (5 languages). Bookings run through Bókun, a third-party booking widget.
THE PROBLEM Google shows too few of our pages. Search Console, Oct 7, 2026: - 1,680 pages indexed, 914 not indexed - About 485 are the real problem: 278 "discovered, not indexed", 117 "duplicate, different canonical", 90 "crawled, not indexed" - Known pages grew from about 500 to 2,600 after we added language versions - 509 clicks in 3 months, almost all from people who already search our brand name We want travelers to find us by searching for tours, not for our name.
Second problem: purchase events from the Bókun checkout (an iframe) do not reach GA4, so we cannot measure bookings.
WHAT WE WANT Phase 1 (this project): a paid audit. No changes to the live site. You deliver a written report with a ranked fix list and a time estimate for each fix. Phase 2 (later, same person if the audit is good): fix indexing, hreflang, canonicals, titles and descriptions, and GSC / GA4 / GTM tracking. Phase 3: keywords, Google Business Profile, content and social media.
YOU MUST HAVE - Technical SEO on WordPress (indexing, canonicals, hreflang, sitemaps) - Google Search Console, GA4 and Google Tag Manager - Experience with multilingual sites (TranslatePress or similar) - Clear written English
HOW WE WORK - Freelancer.com milestones only. No payments, chats or call links (Teams, Zoom) outside the platform. - Google tools by email invitation. We never share passwords. - WordPress at Editor level. Administrator only for one task, with an end date, after a backup. - Backup first. Written reports.
HOW TO APPLY We read every bid. Bids that skip these steps are ignored. Start your bid with the word FRANKFURT. Then answer: 1. List the top 3 causes of "crawled, not indexed" and how you would check each one. 2. How would you get purchase events from a third-party booking iframe into GA4? 3. Link one site whose search traffic you grew, and tell us what you did. 4. Give your fixed price for the Phase 1 audit and how many days it takes.

item.title: Full-Service Amazon Store Management
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | We're launching an Amazon store and need a comprehensive, end-to-end management service. We need you to build out the store design per our concepts. And then expert marketing to drive visibility and sales. Mainly clothing, accessories, home & living items.
Requirements: - Store setup and product listing: We need an appealing and optimized store, with all products listed professionally from the get-go. - Product sourcing: We expect high-quality, trendy clothing that's competitively priced. - Inventory management: Efficient tracking and management of stock levels. - Customer service and returns: Excellent customer service to handle inquiries and returns promptly and professionally.
Ideal Skills: - Proven experience in e-commerce, particularly on Amazon - Strong background in marketing and promotions - Excellent inventory management skills - Customer service expertise - Proven positive track record with end to end Amazon store management. - Experience with Printful to Amazon integrations (Not required but useful)
We will be using Printful as our print-on-demand and dropshipping service. It integrates with Amazon. Please familiarize yourself with that platform.
